description: This file contains implementation of configuration parsing and command-line interface setup for a Radio Unit emulator, including functions for translating PRACH formats, configuring logging, DPDK, and RU emulator parameters, and setting up subcommands for a CLI application.

methods.name: str_to_prach_format
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding RU emulator's PRACH format enum.

methods.name: prach_format_to_str
methods.description: Converts a PRACH format enum to its string representation.

methods.name: configure_cli11_log_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for logging parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_emu_dpdk_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for DPDK parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_emu_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for RU emulator parameters including bandwidth, compression, MAC addresses, VLAN, port IDs, timing, and PRACH format.

methods.name: ocudu::configure_cli11_with_ru_emulator_appconfig_schema
methods.description: Sets up CLI subcommands and options for the RU emulator configuration schema, including logging, cell parameters, and DPDK.
